scope: actual built model and import workspace; isolated VM only

tests.name: the headquarters administrator has import permission and is not denied because routing data is missing
valid import-dependent first transfer returns neutral guidance instead of a configuration error before rows exist
the actual import dialog displays routing guidance and fields neutrally
the sample action is named format example and does not guess the routing value
typing real data clears the old format-example notice and its previous preview
empty or unmatched routing values remain strict row errors with specific field and node explanations
real matching routing data passes the same administrator check without adding a default branch
correcting a failed example into actual matching data removes row errors without a stale top red notice
an impossible first transfer requiring future call or followup facts still reports a configuration issue
START import predicates are also neutral before actual rows, while both known outcomes stay deterministic
a constant unconditional call entry still shows its known method without routing warnings
real configuration issues remain red and are not hidden by neutral guidance
an administrator without actual import action is still denied and no permission is fabricated
